name: Jeeves Operations
description: Request health, latency, model usage and measured quality. Quality tiles use the current jeeves-ui-v2 evaluator implementation. Historical scores remain inspectable; filter by environment. Alerts are disabled.

widgets.name: Jeeves · Requests by environment
widgets.description: Filter by environment before assessing production. Verification runs are synthetic.

widgets.name: Jeeves · Request latency p95
widgets.description: Filter by environment before assessing production. Verification runs are synthetic.

widgets.name: Jeeves · Errors by operation
widgets.description: Filter by environment before assessing production. Verification runs are synthetic.

widgets.name: Jeeves · Model tokens
widgets.description: Filter by environment before assessing production. Verification runs are synthetic.

widgets.name: Jeeves · Measured check pass rates
widgets.description: Only the current jeeves-ui-v2 evaluator implementation. Filter by environment before comparing runs. Historical scores remain available in Scores and trace details; missing semantic labels are not passes.

widgets.name: Jeeves · Unscored checks
widgets.description: Only the current jeeves-ui-v2 evaluator implementation. Filter by environment before comparing runs. Historical scores remain available in Scores and trace details; missing semantic labels are not passes.

widgets.name: Jeeves · Warning observations by operation
widgets.description: Counts warning observations, not unique failed requests. Includes reviewer revisions that can later pass. Filter by environment and inspect the final root outcome.

widgets.name: Jeeves · Blocked packet requests
widgets.description: Counts ui-claim-workflow root warnings, which mark blocked packet outcomes in current builds. Earlier roots may lack the warning signal; reviewer warnings remain visible separately.

widgets.name: Jeeves · Abstained answers
widgets.description: Counts chat-guidance warnings, emitted when no answer passes verification. Clarification pauses and conditional fallbacks are not counted as abstentions.
